correctness.rationale: Exact TR-BDF2 resolvent identity; rigorous path kernel and differentiation; hyperbolic derivative comparison proves strict n-monotonicity for n>=3; exact four-interval Bernstein proof for n=32; exact rational r=10/11 negative certificate for n=33; n=2 direct. value.rationale: The physically meaningful boundary-neighbor heat transfer coefficient is completely classified across all positive step sizes and all path orders. Sharp transition at 32/33 exposes non-monotone spatial transport for an L-stable second-order method even on a simple one-dimensional Neumann diffusion network. The result is more precise than broad SSP insufficiency and identifies a new measurable numerical boundary-layer failure; it does not claim entire-matrix positivity.
